name: Hoarding cleanout
summary: Hoarding cleanouts priced from debris yards, sanitising area, crew days, containers and dump tons.

items.label: Sort and carry out debris
items.source: 1100 sq ft x 8 ft x 30% full x 90% not kept / 27 = 88 cu yd; 1.2 person-h per cu yd / crew 3; 4 x 30-yd containers at 85% load x $550 over 88 yd, plus 0.2 tons/yd x $75/ton dump fee (index.html / sampleInput)

items.label: Deep clean / sanitise
items.source: 90 person-min per 100 sq ft / crew 3, 400 sq ft (index.html); specialist prices no sanitising supplies beyond PPE

items.label: Daily drive, suit-up and containment
items.source: 60 min drive + 45 min setup per day (index.html); 6 crew days from ceil(111.6 person-h / 3 / 6.25 productive h); PPE $18 x 3 people + truck $40 per day

specialistModels: Bills whole 8-hour crew days and whole containers, adds a 10% risk allowance, a $1,500 minimum charge, and volume break-even and change-order rates.
